data.name: LumoraVR
data.detailed_description:
LumoraVR is a social VR platform built on the Godot Engine, designed with community and creativity at its core. It offers users the ability to explore, build, and connect in immersive virtual spaces — featuring real-time world editing capabilities that let creators shape their environments on the fly.

Whether you're hosting events, hanging out with friends, or building your next big idea, LumoraVR aims to provide an open and expressive space for everyone.

Source Available and Community Driven LumoraVR's source code is publicly available, so you can see exactly how the platform works under the hood. The community can contribute directly through GitHub pull requests, and we actively welcome feedback, bug reports, and feature suggestions from anyone who wants to get involved.

Currently in Early Access LumoraVR is in active development. Features will be added, things will change, and your feedback directly shapes what comes next. Join early and help build something worth sticking around for.
